requirement_summary: Notice must be clearly and understandably written, complete, and free of unrelated, confusing, or contradictory material
current_state: Generic template notice that mixes marketing text with privacy terms and does not mention children's information
evidence: Website privacy notice (copy of 2026-07-14); enrollment agreement; student portal sign-in page
gap_description: Notice is incomplete and not written for parents of young children
remediation_action: Rewrite the online notice as a children's privacy notice, reviewed by privacy counsel

requirement_summary: Make reasonable efforts to ensure a parent receives direct notice of practices, including notice of any material change to practices the parent already consented to
current_state: Parents receive the enrollment agreement by email at sign-up; no notice was sent when the vendor switched on the AI progress insights module
evidence: Website privacy notice (copy of 2026-07-14); enrollment agreement; student portal sign-in page; vendor release note for the AI module
gap_description: No direct notice of the material change (AI module)
remediation_action: Send a direct notice of material change before any restart of the AI module; template for future changes

requirement_summary: Direct notice states, if applicable, that the operator collected the parent's or child's online contact information from the child to obtain consent
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company collects contact details from the parent at enrollment, never from the child
current_state: Not applicable
gap_description: None
remediation_action: None

requirement_summary: Direct notice states that parental consent is required and that nothing will be collected, used, or disclosed from the child without it
current_state: Enrollment agreement says the company "may collect information to provide services"; no statement that consent is required; trial accounts are created before enrollment
evidence: Website privacy notice (copy of 2026-07-14); enrollment agreement; student portal sign-in page
gap_description: Required statement missing, and practice contradicts it (trial accounts)
remediation_action: Add the statement to the new direct notice; end trial accounts before consent (see 312.5(a)(1))

requirement_summary: Direct notice lists the items of personal information to be collected from the child, how they will be used, and potential disclosures
current_state: Agreement lists name, grade, and school; it omits user names, voice and video in online sessions and recordings, work samples, messages, and AI analysis
evidence: Website privacy notice (copy of 2026-07-14); enrollment agreement; student portal sign-in page
gap_description: Recordings, work samples, messages, and AI analysis not disclosed
remediation_action: List every item collected through the platform in the direct notice

requirement_summary: Direct notice identifies the third parties (or specific categories) that receive the information and why, and that the parent can consent to collection without consenting to non-integral disclosures
current_state: No third parties named; no option to refuse non-integral disclosures
evidence: Website privacy notice (copy of 2026-07-14); enrollment agreement; student portal sign-in page
gap_description: Third parties and the separate-consent option are missing
remediation_action: Name the platform, scheduling, and suite vendors as service providers and the district for program students; offer separate consent for any non-integral disclosure

requirement_summary: Direct notice links to the online notice
current_state: Agreement footer links to the generic website notice
evidence: Website privacy notice (copy of 2026-07-14); enrollment agreement; student portal sign-in page
gap_description: Link exists but points to a non-compliant notice
remediation_action: Link to the new children's privacy notice

requirement_summary: Direct notice explains how the parent can give verifiable consent
current_state: Agreement explains that signing and paying the enrollment fee by card completes enrollment
gap_description: None
remediation_action: Keep the explanation in the new direct notice

requirement_summary: Direct notice states that contact information collected to seek consent will be deleted if consent is not given within a reasonable time
applies_at_this_tier: No - contact details are collected from parents, not from children, so the 312.5(c)(1) exception is not used
current_state: Not applicable
gap_description: None
remediation_action: None

requirement_summary: Content of the direct notices that go with the 312.5(c)(2), (c)(4), and (c)(5) consent exceptions
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company does not rely on these exceptions
current_state: Not applicable
gap_description: None
remediation_action: None

requirement_summary: Post a prominent, clearly labeled link to the online notice on the home or landing page and at each area where children's information is collected
current_state: Website footer link only; no link on the student portal sign-in page or in the online classroom
evidence: Website privacy notice (copy of 2026-07-14); enrollment agreement; student portal sign-in page
gap_description: No link where children actually sign in and are recorded
remediation_action: Add the link to the student portal and online classroom pages (platform setting)

requirement_summary: Online notice gives the name, address, telephone number, and email address of all operators collecting or maintaining children's information
current_state: Notice gives the company's email only; whether the platform vendor must also be listed has not been considered
evidence: Website privacy notice (copy of 2026-07-14); enrollment agreement; student portal sign-in page
gap_description: Contact details incomplete; operator list not decided
remediation_action: Add full contact details; counsel to confirm whether the platform vendor is listed

requirement_summary: Online notice describes what is collected from children, whether children can make it public, how it is used, disclosure practices with third-party identities or categories and purposes, and the retention policy
current_state: Notice describes website cookies and inquiry forms only
evidence: Website privacy notice (copy of 2026-07-14); enrollment agreement; student portal sign-in page
gap_description: Nothing about children's information, third parties, or retention
remediation_action: Write the full description, including the retention schedule from POL-04 4.9

requirement_summary: Online notice states the internal operations for which persistent identifiers are collected without consent, and how their use is limited
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company obtains consent for all collection and does not rely on the 312.5(c)(7) exception
current_state: Not applicable
gap_description: None
remediation_action: None

requirement_summary: Online notice describes use of children's audio files collected under the 312.5(c)(9) exception
applies_at_this_tier: No - online session audio is collected with consent, not under the audio-file exception
current_state: Not applicable
gap_description: None
remediation_action: None

requirement_summary: Online notice states, if applicable, that the parent can review or delete the child's information and refuse further collection, and how
current_state: Not stated
evidence: Website privacy notice (copy of 2026-07-14); enrollment agreement; student portal sign-in page
gap_description: Parents are not told about their rights or how to use them
remediation_action: Add the parent request procedure (POL-04 4.10) to the notice

requirement_summary: Obtain verifiable parental consent before any collection, use, or disclosure of a child's information, including consent to material changes
current_state: Private-pay families consent at enrollment; about 35 trial accounts for prospective students were created in 2026 before any consent; no new consent was sought when the AI module was switched on
evidence: SYS-01 trial account list; SYS-02 consent records; vendor release note
gap_description: Collection before consent (trial accounts); no consent to a material change
remediation_action: Consent step before any account is created; end trial accounts; delete trial data without consent; new consent before any AI module restart

requirement_summary: Let the parent consent to collection and use without consenting to disclosure to third parties unless integral; obtain separate consent for non-integral disclosures
current_state: No option offered. Vendor terms allow de-identified data to improve its AI models; the FTC states in the 2025 final rule that disclosures to train or develop AI are not integral (90 FR 16918)
evidence: Platform terms of service; P10 review
gap_description: Possible non-integral disclosure without separate consent
remediation_action: Data processing addendum barring model training (R-008); separate consent if any non-integral disclosure is ever made

requirement_summary: Use a consent method reasonably calculated to ensure the person consenting is the parent (listed methods include a card transaction with notice to the account holder)
current_state: Card payment of the enrollment fee meets 312.5(b)(2)(ii) for most families; about 20 families pay by bank debit with only a check box; district students rely on the district's authorization with no written scope
gap_description: No listed method for bank-debit families; school authorization scope not documented
remediation_action: Signed consent form (312.5(b)(2)(i)) for bank-debit families; written district authorization limited to the program's educational purpose, in line with the FTC's existing ed-tech guidance

requirement_summary: Exception: collect a parent's or child's name or contact information only to seek consent; delete if consent is not obtained in a reasonable time
applies_at_this_tier: No - not used; contact details come from the parent
current_state: Not applicable
gap_description: None
remediation_action: None

requirement_summary: Other exceptions to prior parental consent (voluntary notice, one-time response, multiple contacts, safety, security and liability, internal operations, audio files)
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company does not rely on these exceptions
current_state: Not applicable
gap_description: None
remediation_action: None

requirement_summary: On a parent's request, describe the specific types or categories of information collected from the child
current_state: Two requests in 2026, answered by email with a partial list
gap_description: No standard answer; recordings and messages left out
remediation_action: Standard response listing every category

requirement_summary: Give the parent the opportunity to refuse further use or collection and to direct deletion of the child's information
current_state: Deletion requests remove the family account in SYS-02 only; platform records, recordings, and suite files remain
evidence: Parent request emails; SYS-01 record check
gap_description: Deletion incomplete across systems
remediation_action: Deletion checklist covering SYS-01, SYS-02, SYS-03, and backups (deleted as versions expire)

requirement_summary: Provide a means for the parent to review any information collected from the child
current_state: Parents see progress reports in the portal; recordings, messages, and work samples are not offered
gap_description: Review limited to reports
remediation_action: Offer review of recordings, messages, and work samples on request

requirement_summary: The review means must ensure the requester is the child's parent
current_state: No identity check; one 2026 request came from an email address not on the family account and was answered
gap_description: An impostor or non-custodial adult could obtain or delete a child's information
remediation_action: Verify through the parent portal sign-in or a call-back to the phone number on file; log every request

requirement_summary: The review means must not be unduly burdensome to the parent
current_state: Requests are accepted by email or at the front desk and answered within a week
gap_description: None
remediation_action: Keep the simple process when adding verification

requirement_summary: Do not condition a child's participation in a game, prize, or activity on disclosing more information than reasonably necessary
current_state: Platform badges and rewards require no extra information; no contests
gap_description: None
remediation_action: None

requirement_summary: Establish and maintain reasonable procedures to protect the confidentiality, security, and integrity of children's information
current_state: Some safeguards (suite MFA, laptop encryption, MSP patching); many gaps (see 312.8(b)(3))
gap_description: Procedures informal and incomplete
remediation_action: Operate the written program (P02 and P06)

requirement_summary: Establish, implement, and maintain a written information security program with safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of children's information and the operator's size, complexity, and activities (compliance date April 22, 2026)
current_state: No written program at the end of fieldwork; the compliance date had passed
gap_description: Written program missing almost four months after the compliance date
remediation_action: Adopt the SSP (P02) and policies (P06) as the written program; approved 2026-08-28

requirement_summary: Designate one or more employees to coordinate the program
current_state: Center Director designated in writing on 2026-07-13
gap_description: None
remediation_action: Update the designation within 30 days of any change (POL-02 A.1)

requirement_summary: Identify and, at least annually, assess internal and external risks to children's information and the sufficiency of safeguards
current_state: First risk assessment completed 2026-07-24 (P01); no inventory of where children's information lives
gap_description: No annual cycle yet; no data inventory, so the assessment may miss locations
remediation_action: Inventory of systems and children's data; repeat each July

requirement_summary: Design, implement, and maintain safeguards based on the volume and sensitivity of children's information and the likelihood of compromise
current_state: No MFA in the tutoring platform; open "Student files" folder; rosters on contractors' personal computers; shared Wi-Fi segment
evidence: Platform settings; shared-drive permission report; contractor interviews; firewall export
gap_description: Key safeguards missing for the most sensitive data
remediation_action: MFA enforcement; folder restriction; contractor device rules; network segmentation (P01 R-002, R-003, R-005, R-014)

requirement_summary: Regularly test and monitor the effectiveness of the safeguards
current_state: No log review, no restore tests, no prior assessment
gap_description: Nothing is tested or monitored
remediation_action: Monthly log and account review; quarterly restore tests; annual independent assessment (P07 started 2026-08-03)

requirement_summary: At least annually, evaluate and modify the program for identified risks, test results, new methods, and material changes
current_state: No program to evaluate yet
gap_description: No annual evaluation process
remediation_action: Annual program review each August, after the July risk assessment (POL-02 A.8)

requirement_summary: Before letting service providers or third parties collect, maintain, or receive children's information, take reasonable steps to confirm they can protect it and obtain written assurances
current_state: No written security assurances from the platform, scheduling, or suite vendors or the MSP; platform SOC 2 report never requested before July 2026; no contractor tutor security terms
evidence: Vendor contracts and terms; contractor agreement
gap_description: No due diligence or written assurances
remediation_action: Data processing addendum with security assurances from the platform vendor; review SOC 2 report yearly; MSP and contractor agreement terms

requirement_summary: Retain children's information only as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose collected
current_state: Records of about 1,900 former students and all recordings since 2019 are kept
gap_description: Records kept far beyond their purpose
remediation_action: Retention schedule (POL-04 4.9) and first purge

requirement_summary: Delete information no longer needed using reasonable measures to protect against unauthorized access during deletion
current_state: No deletion process; paper intake forms go in regular recycling
gap_description: No secure deletion or disposal
remediation_action: Deletion record; locked shred bin for paper

requirement_summary: Children's information may not be retained indefinitely
current_state: Platform default keeps records and recordings with no end date
gap_description: Indefinite retention
remediation_action: Set platform retention: recordings 90 days; former students 2 years after the last session

requirement_summary: Establish, implement, and maintain a written data retention policy stating purposes, business need, and deletion timeframe
current_state: None
gap_description: No written retention policy
remediation_action: POL-04 4.9 approved 2026-08-28; implement by 2026-11-30

requirement_summary: Provide the written retention policy in the online notice
current_state: Not provided
evidence: Website privacy notice (copy of 2026-07-14); enrollment agreement; student portal sign-in page
gap_description: Retention policy not in the notice
remediation_action: Include in the new online notice

requirement_summary: Safe harbor programs (voluntary self-regulatory guidelines approved by the FTC)
applies_at_this_tier: No - a voluntary program; the company is not a member
current_state: Not applicable
gap_description: None
remediation_action: None

requirement_summary: As a contractor treated as a school official, perform an institutional service and stay under the district's direct control for the use and maintenance of education records
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - district contract and data privacy agreement
current_state: The company uses the roster only for the program, but the district cannot see or control copies on contractor tutors' personal computers
evidence: District contract and DPA; contractor interviews
gap_description: District data outside any controlled system
remediation_action: Rosters only in the platform; contractor deletion attestations (P01 R-005)

requirement_summary: Do not disclose information from education records to any other party without prior consent
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - district contract and data privacy agreement
current_state: No known disclosures to other parties. The platform vendor's terms allow de-identified data for model improvement, and district students were scored by the AI module
gap_description: Possible vendor use beyond the program
remediation_action: Data processing addendum barring model training; AI module off (R-008)

requirement_summary: Officers, employees, and agents may use the information only for the purposes for which it was disclosed
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - district contract and data privacy agreement
current_state: Contractor tutors use rosters only for sessions, but have no written rule; AI module scores of district students were produced without district approval
gap_description: No written purpose limit for contractors; AI use not approved by the district
remediation_action: New contractor agreement with a purpose limit; district approval before any AI use for program students

requirement_summary: Reasonable methods so that school officials reach only records in which they have a legitimate educational interest (the district's duty, flowed down in the DPA)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - district contract and data privacy agreement
current_state: The platform limits tutors to assigned students, but the emailed rosters list every program student
gap_description: Each tutor sees all 90 students' data
remediation_action: Platform-only access by assignment (R-005)
